title: Indiana taps its director of digital governance to also serve as chief privacy officer
summary: John Stark takes on the role as the state’s privacy lead in addition to his role leading the state’s digital governance efforts.

title: States confront growing cyber gaps as critical infrastructure threats rise, report finds
summary: The joint report from NASCIO and GDIT highlights unreliable funding sources, fewer resources in smaller jurisdictions and the increased risks in connecting critical infrastructure systems to the internet as major concerns for state chief information officers.

title: California launches AI assistant to help residents navigate state services
summary: The tool uses Anthropic’s Claude model and will rely on state subject matter experts to help validate responses from verified sources, rather than simply generate conversational answers like many commercial AI chatbots.

title: Virginia forms digital service office, appoints former federal Medicare leader as new director
summary: Virginia’s new digital services team comes after the state recently discovered millions in “bad state contracts” for IT projects that were never completed.

title: Center for Internet Security launches AI cyber defense pilot for state and local governments
summary: The pilot comes as public-sector cybersecurity teams face increasingly sophisticated threats, often while operating with limited staff and resources.

title: NASCIO picks finalists for 2026 State IT Recognition Awards
summary: The National Association of State Chief Information Officers shared this year’s finalists for the State IT Recognition Awards.

title: NTIA shares long-awaited update on use of leftover BEAD funds
summary: The agency clarified that states can now use leftover BEAD funds to fund broadband projects in locations that were missed or became newly eligible.

title: Report calls for rebuilding federal education data infrastructure with states at the center
summary: The report, published by the American Statistical Association, recommends stronger data governance, improved interoperability and expanded technical capacity — both at the federal and state levels.

title: Massachusetts’ first heat resilience officer eyes data, technology for statewide response to extreme heat
summary: Katie Schlick said her initial priority will be building the data infrastructure needed to understand how extreme heat is affecting communities, critical infrastructure like utilities, public health and the state’s economy.

title: Colorado launches mobile driver’s license for use at TSA checkpoints
summary: The mobile driver’s license will be accepted at Denver International Airport along with 250 other participating airports.
